song.name: Phantom Realm
song.plot: Acheron explores the interstitial planar rift between Eldoria and the Void. He discovers how to harvest soul energy to bank it in subterranean vaults, securing his Covenant's immortality.
song.analysis: The original is a generic "vampire empire expands" piece. The reworked version anchors it to the canonical Vampiric Soul-Leak: Acheron discovering the interstitial planar seam, siphoning souls, and banking them in subterranean vaults to secure the Covenant's immortality. "Their agents rule behind the throne" matches the Covenant's hidden control of mortal kingdoms. Preserves the 5-verse structure and 7-8 syllable meter. Suggested song direction: ethereal, eerie, subterranean — dissonant strings, deep drones, echoing whispers.
